story_zh: 在绝对的沉默中，李哲彻底思考存在的抽象概念。他假设人生由各种成分组成，从单纯到成熟需要持续成长。通过逻辑分析，他得出结论：真正的独立不是躲藏，而是勇敢面对现实。这促进了他思想的形成，从而创造了自己的人生意义。
story_pinyin: Zài juéduì de chénmò zhōng, Lǐ Zhé chèdǐ sīkǎo cúnzài de chōuxiàng gàiniàn. Tā jiǎshè rénshēng yóu gèzhǒng chéngfèn zǔchéng, cóng dānchún dào chéngshú xūyào chíxù chéngzhǎng. Tōngguò luójí fēnxī, tā déchū jiélùn: Zhēnzhèng de dúlì bùshì duǒcáng, ér shì yǒnggǎn miànduì xiànshí. Zhè cùjìnle tā sīxiǎng de xíngchéng, cóng'ér chuàngzàole zìjǐ de rénshēng yìyì.
story_en: In absolute silence, Li Zhe thoroughly contemplated the abstract concept of existence. He hypothesized that life is composed of various components, requiring continuous growth from simplicity to maturity. Through logical analysis, he concluded: true independence is not hiding, but bravely facing reality. This facilitated the formation of his thoughts, thereby creating his own meaning of life.
